column1: # The Test262 cost register: selected tests whose full run exceeds the CI
# lane's cost bound (FIG-3729). The runner records each as
# `harness instruction-cost` without executing it. A test enters the register
# only with a ticket, only when it exceeds the bound, and never to hide a
# wrong answer; it leaves when the VM runs it inside the bound again.

column2: exhaustive 4-byte UTF-8 sweep: about 9e7 instructions since bitwise operators run natively, but about 2 minutes of fastbuild wall clock; tracked by FIG-3730 (VM dispatch cost)
